facts.fact: 不用职业猎妖人也看得出，这里是森林的心脏，是屏障变薄的中心。
facts.anchor: It did not take a professional yiugwai hunter to figure out this was the heart of the forest.

facts.fact: 树身裂口里嵌着一个长发女人的半边身子。
facts.anchor: Inside the gap, the figure of a woman with long dark hair was partially enfolded.

facts.fact: 她抽出那把一直没还给屠夫冯的短铁菜刀。
facts.anchor: Kiamling unsheathed the short iron cleaver that she had never returned to Butcher Fung

facts.fact: 树根当场收紧，把被俘的人往树洞里拽。
facts.anchor: Then the roots visibly tightened, pulling the captive further into the hollow.

facts.fact: 那女人嘶哑地低声叫她趁还能走的时候赶紧走。
facts.anchor: “Get out, while you still can,” she said in a hoarse whisper.

facts.fact: 被缠住的是 Madam Yau，头发散在脸上，几乎认不出来。
facts.anchor: It was Madam Yau, almost unrecognisable with her hair loose across her face.

facts.fact: Madam Yau 让她去找 Jingling，话没说完。
facts.anchor: “Find Jingling. She can…”

facts.fact: 有人用英语问她是不是“她们”里的一个。
facts.anchor: “Are you one of them?” a voice said in English.

facts.fact: 男孩说她们是勾引好男人的娼妇。
facts.anchor: “One of these strumpets who bewitch good men.”

facts.fact: 他说自己用她自己的法子逮住了她，把她困在树里。
facts.anchor: “But I caught her with her own trick. Trap me in a tree.”

facts.fact: 他撕下符纸，符上的驱邪字迹却像纹身一样印进了皮肤。
facts.anchor: He ripped the fu off, but its words of exorcism had smeared onto his skin like a tattoo.

facts.fact: 他变成一脸麻子、下巴留黑胡子、手里握着樵夫斧头的男人。
facts.anchor: His face pockmarked, a dark beard covering his chin and a woodcutter’s axe in his hand.

facts.fact: Jingling 让她把那人引开，引离那棵大树。
facts.anchor: “Distract him, get him away from the big tree.”

facts.fact: Jingling 让她信自己，说自己能把 Madam Yau 弄出来。
facts.anchor: “Trust me, Ah Kiam. I can get Madam Yau out.

facts.fact: 她对自己说，这一次要信妹妹。
facts.anchor: She needed to trust.

facts.fact: 她把剑砸进树身裂口，一直捅到几乎没柄。
facts.anchor: She slammed her sword down into the crack, thrusting it until it would go no further, nearly to the hilt.

facts.fact: 他搬出湖中仙女的名字，说每个女人都是野心勃勃的娼妇。
facts.anchor: “Viviane, Nimuë, Lady of the Lake. You are everywoman, and each of you an ambitious harlot.”

facts.fact: 他回了一句“可她们撑不住”，随后朝下扑去。
facts.anchor: “But they can’t,” he said.

facts.fact: 他的手和脚变成白色蹄子，头上长出枝杈。
facts.anchor: His arms and legs became white hooves, and branches burst from his head.

facts.fact: 她的功夫是广东十虎教出来的。
facts.anchor: Kiamling had been taught by the Ten Tigers of Canton.
